Meal Rotation Planner

Food data comes from USDA FoodData Central (April 2026 download): Foundation Foods, SR Legacy, and FNDDS 2021–2023, plus a short starter list. All values are per 100 g. Your meals and plans are saved in this browser and, when the page is open in claude.ai, synced to your account so your phone and computer match.
